# Split pane (`split-pane`)

Resizable, collapsible panes.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createList` (types in `dist/web/data-display/list.d.ts`): `ul.mh-list`: rows with a leading icon or avatar, title, subtitle and trailing slot. `--dividers`, `--inset`.

```ts
export function createList(options: ListOptions): ListHandle;

export interface ListOptions {
  items: ListItemOptions[];
  /** Rules between rows (default true). */
  dividers?: boolean;
  /** Rows in a rounded surface, settings style. */
  inset?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  label?: string;
}

export interface ListHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  setItems(items: ListItemOptions[]): void;
}

export interface ListItemOptions {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A leading icon in a soft square. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A leading element instead of the icon (an avatar). */
  leading?: HTMLElement;
  /** Trailing content: a value ("On", "21°") or an element (a badge, a switch on a non-pressable row). */
  trailing?: Child;
  /** Shows a chevron: the row opens something. */
  chevron?: boolean;
  /** Makes the row a button. Don't combine with an interactive `trailing` control. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  /** Makes the row a link. */
  href?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Marks the current row (`aria-current`). */
  current?: boolean;
  tone?: 'default' | 'danger';
}
```

`createSplitPane` (types in `dist/web/layout/splitPane.d.ts`): `.mh-split` (`--vertical`, `--collapse-start | --collapse-end`; states `.is-collapsed`, `.is-resizing`): two panes (`__pane--start`, `__pane--end`) with a draggable `role="separator"` divider (`__handle` with a `__grip`) between them. The start pane's share is the `--_size` custom property.

```ts
export function createSplitPane(options: SplitPaneOptions = {}): SplitPaneHandle;

export interface SplitPaneOptions extends SplitPaneBehaviour {
  start?: Child | Child[];
  end?: Child | Child[];
  /** Accessible name of the divider (default "Resize panes"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Accessible names of the panes; a named pane becomes a region. */
  startLabel?: string;
  endLabel?: string;
}

export interface SplitPaneHandle extends Omit<SplitPaneController, 'destroy'> {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  startPane: HTMLDivElement;
  endPane: HTMLDivElement;
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`createStack` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): `.mh-stack`: children in a column or (`--row`) a row, spaced by `--mh-space-*` (`--gap-<step>`, default `md`).

```ts
export function createStack(options: StackOptions = {}, ...children: Child[]):;

export interface StackOptions {
  /** `column` (default) or `row`. */
  direction?: 'column' | 'row';
  gap?: Space;
  align?: StackAlign;
  justify?: StackJustify;
  /** Rows wrap onto more lines. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  /** Element to render (default `div`). */
  as?: 'div' | 'section' | 'ul' | 'ol' | 'nav' | 'header' | 'footer';
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createList, createSplitPane, createStack, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Office'];
const title = createText('Living room', { variant: 'title' });
const status = createText('Room list at 35%', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const list = createList({
  label: 'Rooms',
  items: rooms.map((room) => ({ title: room, icon: 'home', onClick: () => (title.textContent = room) })),
});

const split = createSplitPane({
  start: list.el,
  end: createStack({ gap: 'sm' }, title, createText('3 lights on, 21.5°.', { tone: 'muted' })).el,
  size: 35,
  min: 25,
  max: 65,
  collapsible: 'start',
  label: 'Resize room list',
  startLabel: 'Rooms',
  onResize: (size) => (status.textContent = `Room list at ${size}%`),
  onCollapse: (collapsed) => (status.textContent = collapsed ? 'Room list folded away' : 'Room list shown'),
});
// The panes fill the split's height, so it needs one.
split.el.style.height = '320px';

document.body.append(split.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { List, ListItem, SplitPane, Stack, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const ROOMS = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Office'];

export function SplitPaneExample() {
  const [size, setSize] = useState(35);
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [room, setRoom] = useState('Living room');
  const list = (
    <List label="Rooms">
      {ROOMS.map((r) => (
        <ListItem key={r} title={r} icon="home" current={r === room} onClick={() => setRoom(r)} />
      ))}
    </List>
  );
  return (
    <div style={{ height: 320 }}>
      <SplitPane
        start={list}
        end={
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <Text variant="title">{room}</Text>
            <Text tone="muted">3 lights on, 21.5°.</Text>
          </Stack>
        }
        size={size}
        min={25}
        max={65}
        collapsible="start"
        collapsed={collapsed}
        label="Resize room list"
        startLabel="Rooms"
        onResize={setSize}
        onCollapse={setCollapsed}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
